Dave is smart (fact). Applying Rule 3 (If Dave is smart then Dave is white), we derive Dave is white. Applying Rule 1 (If Dave is white then Dave is round), we derive Dave is round. Therefore, the statement "Dave is not round" is false.

ANSWER: False
